scenario: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample after ordinary NOR boot, run one bounded strict-SAE baseline, connected scan and explicit ROAM to a fresh compatible alternate; verify that the requested alternate differs from baseline and matches the final BSSID, then check WPA status, IPv4, DNS and gateway reachability.
expected: Baseline and scan remain associated; the accepted roam completes on the requested alternate; post-roam strict SAE/PMF, IPv4, DNS and gateway reachability succeed.
observed: The combined 44b FIT and 10 MiB root write passed built-in verification; SPL was retained. Ordinary POWER boot selected the 44b FIT and mounted the current LittleFS root from flash1. Baseline WPA status was COMPLETED with SAE and PMF=1. A fresh connected scan preserved the original association. ROAM reached the requested alternate BSSID, which differed from baseline and matched the final BSSID. Both baseline and post-roam status were COMPLETED with SAE and PMF=1; IPv4 was present, DNS resolution succeeded and bounded gateway ping succeeded.

limits: One operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample and one bounded strict-SAE connected-scan/ROAM run; this does not establish repeated-roam reliability or support for other revisions.
This record covers connected scan and station-initiated ROAM only. RRM/BTM peer behavior is recorded separately in the bounded Action transport evidence.
AP-initiated BTM/802.11v, 802.11r, forged-frame protection, throughput and sustained reliability remain unverified.
